title: Resultative complements
simpleExplanation: A second verb or adjective indicates the result: 听懂 = listen and understand.
technicalExplanation: Resultative complements form verb-result compounds. The potential form is made with 得/不 inserted: 听得懂 / 听不懂.
usage: 做完作业, 看懂了, 买到了.
avoidWhen: Do not translate «can» with 能 when the potential form is appropriate: 听不懂, not 不能听懂.

title: The 把 construction
simpleExplanation: 把 moves the object forward to emphasize what happens to it: 把门关上 = «close the door».
technicalExplanation: The 把 construction requires a definite object and a verb with a complement (result, direction, 了…). It expresses manipulation or change of state of the object.
usage: 请把书放在桌子上。
avoidWhen: Not with perception or state verbs (看见, 喜欢, 是, 有) nor with indefinite objects.

title: Degree complement with 得
simpleExplanation: 得 links a verb and an evaluation: 说得很好 = «speaks very well».
technicalExplanation: The state/degree complement describes how the action is performed. If the verb takes an object, the verb is repeated: 说汉语说得很好, or the object is topicalized.
usage: 他跑得很快。你写得真漂亮。
avoidWhen: Do not confuse the three de: 的 (nominal), 地 (adverbial), 得 (complement).

title: Directional complements
simpleExplanation: 来/去 after the verb indicate direction relative to the speaker: 进来 (come in towards me), 出去 (go out).

title: 已经…了 and 还没…呢
pattern: 已经 + V + 了 / 还没(有) + V (+呢)
